title: The warning
place: A caravanserai near Kerman, Persia, about 1272, the evening before the raid.

accuracy.source: Marco Polo, Travels, Yule-Cordier ed. (Project Gutenberg #10636); Claude with ChatGPT (text only), 2026-11-26
findings: A caravanserai (ribat) is a square walled courtyard with arcaded rooms on all four sides and one gate.
No warning scene is in Polo: our dramatisation.
The raiders were Mongol bands (Caraonas), so the warning comes from a Persian caravan master.

layout.status: Draft blocking for the storyboard (Nov 26 2026); distances are a first proposal.

landmarks.label: courtyard fire

cells.action: Inside the square walled caravanserai at dusk, arcaded rooms on all four sides and one arched gate; travellers sit round a fire, camels rest along the walls.

where.marco: the young man in white by the fire

cells.action: A Persian caravan master by the fire leans in and warns: Caraonas raiders roam the plain.
Marco listens, wide-eyed, firelight on his face.
Maffeo frowns; Niccolò waves the warning off with one hand.

where.niccolo: the older man with the grey beard, waving his hand
